data.one_liner: Dart client library for Google Maps Web Services APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed wrappers for Google Maps Web Services such as Geocoding, Places (legacy and new), Directions, Distance Matrix, Timezone and Static Maps. Handles HTTP requests, authentication via API key or token, and response parsing.
use_when: You need server‑side or Flutter access to Google Maps data without embedding a map widget
You want a single package covering multiple Google Maps APIs with customizable HTTP client
avoid_when: You need an interactive map UI
You require offline or on‑device map data
strengths: Covers most Google Maps Web Services in one package
Supports both legacy and new Places APIs
Allows custom interceptors, headers and proxy base URLs
weaknesses: No map rendering widgets, only web service calls
Requires a valid web API key and may incur usage costs
Limited to Dart; not a full Flutter UI solution

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides native map widgets for iOS/Android when UI map is needed

alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight package if you only need geocoding functionality
